priorityList: Pre-combat: Summon your pet (or use Grimoire of Sacrifice) and cast Haunt.
Maintain Haunt on your primary target at all times.
Maintain Agony on the target, refreshing when it is in pandemic range.
Maintain Wither on the target, refreshing when it is in pandemic range.
Cast Dark Harvest if its cast time is shorter than the remaining duration of Agony or Wither.
Refresh Agony early if it has less than 20 seconds remaining and Summon Darkglare is ready to be cast.
Cast Malevolence while Summon Darkglare is active.
Use offensive trinkets, potions, and racial cooldowns (like Berserking or Blood Fury) while your major cooldowns are active.
Cast Malefic Grasp if you have more than one stack of Nightfall or if Summon Darkglare is about to expire.
Cast Drain Soul (or Shadow Bolt) if you have more than one stack of Nightfall.
Spend Soul Shards on Unstable Affliction if Summon Darkglare or Malevolence is active, if you are at 5 Soul Shards, or if you have a Shard Instability proc.
Refresh Unstable Affliction if the Cascading Calamity buff is about to expire.
Use Malefic Grasp as your primary filler while Summon Darkglare is active.
Use Drain Soul (or Shadow Bolt) as your filler when no other priorities are available.
